meta.name: hunt-exceptional-conditions
meta.description: Hunt mishandling of exceptional conditions — feed an endpoint malformed/unexpected input (wrong type, broken JSON, oversized field, null byte) and make it fail OPEN or leak internals: a verbose stack-trace / framework error page that discloses ORM internals, server file paths, library versions, or a language traceback. Use on any input-accepting endpoint (JSON APIs, forms, query params). Medium-High when the leak exposes internal structure that arms a deeper attack.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试接口对异常输入的容错与信息泄露风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发或上线前检查接口对异常输入的处理是否安全。
copy.tagline_en: Test endpoints for mishandling of exceptional conditions and information leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check how your endpoints handle malformed input before deployment.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会向目标接口发送格式错误或意外的输入（如错误类型、损坏的 JSON、超长字段、空字节），并检查响应是否泄露了堆栈跟踪、ORM 内部信息、服务器文件路径或库版本等内部细节。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试一个接受输入的接口（如 JSON API、表单、查询参数）时触发。

say.text: 测试这个 API 端点，发送一个类型错误的字段。
检查这个接口对损坏 JSON 的处理。
对这个查询参数发送一个超长字符串。
say.note: Claude 会发送一个超长字符串，并观察是否触发错误泄露。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude sends malformed or unexpected input (wrong type, broken JSON, oversized field, null byte) to a target endpoint and checks if the response leaks internal details such as stack traces, ORM internals, server file paths, or library versions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to test an input-accepting endpoint (e.g., JSON API, form, query parameter).

say_en.text: Test this API endpoint by sending a wrong type field.
Check how this endpoint handles malformed JSON.
say_en.note: Claude will send a malformed JSON request and analyze the response.

say_en.text: Send an oversized string to this query parameter.
say_en.note: Claude will send an extremely long string and observe if an error leak occurs.
